clusters.mechanism: textAt classifies any blob containing the literal "%PDF-" anywhere as binary, so text files mentioning the PDF magic number are wrongly reported as having NUL/binary bytes.
A pre-existing config-cache test assertion fails on both base and head (expects one config listing but gets two), unrelated to this patch.
The new INERT_MEDIA_PATH guard lets a mode change with an identical blob (regular file to symlink, 100644 to 120000) pass unflagged, dropping the incidental check that base provided.
